article.title: Meticulous
article.description: Meaning: showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise. Example: 'She kept meticulous records of every transaction.' Synonyms: thorough, painstaking, precise. Useful in describing work habits — common in job interview English.
article.content: Meaning: showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise. Example: 'She kept meticulous records of every transaction.' Synonyms: thorough, painstaking, precise. Useful in describing work habits — common in job interview English.

generated.caption:
Want to sound super professional when describing great attention to detail?

Today's word is 'meticulous'! It means paying incredibly close attention to every detail, being very careful and precise. It's perfect for describing thorough work habits, especially in job interviews.

For example: 'She kept meticulous records of every transaction.'

generated.script: Apne kaam ko perfectly describe karne ke liye right word nahi milta na? Meticulous. Iska matlab hai jab aap koi kaam bohot hi zyaada attention to detail ke saath karte ho, ekdum careful aur precise tareeke se. For example, 'She kept meticulous records of every transaction.' Matlab usne har transaction ka record bohot dhyan se aur accurately rakha. Toh ab se jab bhi aapko apne kaam ko ya kisi aur ke work habits ko 'very careful and precise' describe karna ho, toh the word is 'meticulous'! Comment mein batao, kya aap bhi apne kaam mein meticulous ho?

slides.body: To be meticulous means showing great attention to detail, being extremely careful and precise in your work or actions. It goes beyond just being careful; it implies a thoroughness that leaves no stone unturned. For instance, 'She kept meticulous records of every transaction' perfectly illustrates someone who is highly organized and exact. This word is particularly useful when describing excellent work habits and is often heard in professional contexts, especially during job interviews, to highlight a candidate's attention to detail.
